observations.observation: Full dark forest-green product remains visible. Broad curved shade, two parallel columns connected to shared shade and oval base, and stable desk contact are clear. Shade/base use restrained painted green/ochre planes.
One coherent painted desktop still life: warm light reaches cream book pages and joined paper; red-brown desk and purple evening background remain. No mockup frame or multiple poster panels.
Description is bolder and larger than repair-1; exact sentences read in three text lines after title/English name. It remains the densest group but is now readily distinguishable from page texture.
Visit conditions, bringing-book instruction and URL are visibly larger and heavier than repair-1. Entire final sentence and URL can be read through the joined page-paper route.
Event, date, time and place retain one adjacent group; aligned beginnings lead naturally from left explanation to right visit paper.
Lamp-light-book is first pictorial anchor, left page title and center event form linked anchors, right paper is an evident third reading group. Fine body is below thumbnail reading scale.

Korean serif counters stay open under increased weight. Latin/date weight is proportionate. Copy visually read once; optical letter tracking and gaps near weekday dash are visible. Raster reading does not certify Unicode encoding or hidden spacing.
